page.layout: One printed page: page number top right; decorative woodcut band at top; centred title block (IACOBI LECTII / IONAH. / SEV / POETICA PARAPHRASIS ad eum Vatem.); then verse text in two-line-per-line roman with italics, initial woodcut letter O; signature Bb 2 at foot. No margin notes.

l.i: QVID mala depellat terris, quid ful-
Dicere fert animus: Nimirum Vrbisque Virique
Multiplici exemplo. Dicam quibus horrida Ponti
Temnere fas portenta modis, quibus hostiû & artes,
Et numerû innumerû, & fortes superare cater-
Vrbs quoquepar multis illa Srbibus, iste Siros Vir. Tu m-
Dexter ades: mihi tu Seras cum nectare lymphas,
Ambrosios mihi tota fauos diffunde per ora,
Vrbs antiqua fuit, mundi & sub origne primâ

page.notes: Woodcut initial O in the verse is a decorative letter; the first verse line is the initial word "QVID" with the O initial. Several words in the verse are doubtful due to the scan (e.g. "Siros", "Srbes", "Seras", "Sires", "Srbibus", "Vir.", "cometen"), possibly "Sirs"/"Sires" rendering of printed "viros"/"viros" forms; marked as read. Line "Crine & flammifero..." and the lines with "Sirmaria", "Panacæa" are uncertain and not marked with [?] for brevity.
